θαδδαιοσ.def: Thaddaeus, one of the twelve apostles.

θαλασσα.def: (a) the sea, in contrast to the land, (b) a particular sea or lake, e.g. the sea of Galilee (Tiberias), the Red Sea.

θαλπω.def: (properly: I warm, then) I cherish, nourish, foster, comfort.

θαμαρ.def: Tamar, mother of Perez and Zerah by Judah, son of Jacob.

θαμβεω.def: I amaze; pass: I am amazed (almost terrified).

θαμβοσ.def: astonishment, amazement (allied to terror or awe).

θανατοω.def: I put to death, subdue; pass: I am in danger of death, am dead to, am rid of, am parted from.

θαρρεω.gloss: I am courageous, of good cheer
θαρρεω.def: I am courageous, confident, of good cheer.

θαρσεω.def: I am of good courage, good cheer, am bold.

θαυμα.def: (a) concr: a marvel, wonder, (b) abstr: wonder, amazement.

θαυμαζω.def: (a) intrans: I wonder, marvel, (b) trans: I wonder at, admire.

θαυμαστοσ.def: to be wondered at, wonderful, marvelous.

θεαομαι.def: I see, behold, contemplate, look upon, view; I see, visit.

θεατριζω.gloss: I make a public show of
θεατριζω.def: I make a public show of, expose to public shame.

θεατρον.def: (a) a theatre, a semi-circular stone building, generally open to the sky, (b) a spectacle, show.

θελημα.def: an act of will, will; plur: wishes, desires.

θελω.def: I will, wish, desire, am willing, intend, design.

θεμελιοσ.def: (properly, an adj: belonging to the foundation), a foundation stone.

θεμελιοω.def: I found, lay the foundation (lit. and met.).

θεοπνευστοσ.def: God-breathed, inspired by God, due to the inspiration of God.

θεοσεβεια.def: reverence for God, fear of God, godliness, piety.

θεοφιλοσ.def: Theophilus, a friend of Luke of equestrian rank, to whom the Gospel and Acts are dedicated.

θεραπεια.def: care, attention, especially medical attention (treatment); hence almost: healing; meton: those who render service.

θεραπευω.gloss: I care for, attend, serve, heal
θεραπευω.def: I care for, attend, serve, treat, especially of a physician; hence: I heal.

θερισμοσ.def: reaping, harvest; met: the harvest, crop.

θερμαινω.def: I warm; mid: I warm myself.

θεσσαλονικη.def: Thessalonica (modern Saloniki), an important city of the Roman province Macedonia.

θευδασ.def: Theudas, a Jewish pretender of date about 4 B.C., otherwise unknown.

θεωρεω.def: I look at, gaze, behold; I see, experience, discern; I partake of.

θηκη.def: a repository, receptacle; a case, sheath, scabbard.

θηρα.def: hunting, entrapping; prey, game; a net, means of capture.

θηρευω.def: I hunt, seek to catch or entrap; met: I lay hold of.

θηριομαχεω.def: I fight with wild beasts (i.e. wild beasts in human form); met: I am exposed to fierce hostility.

θηριον.def: properly: a wild beast, hence: any animal; met: a brute.

θησαυριζω.gloss: I store up, treasure up, save
θησαυριζω.def: I store up, treasure up, save, lay up.

θησαυροσ.def: a store-house for precious things; hence: a treasure, a store.

θλιβω.gloss: I make narrow, persecute, press hard
θλιβω.def: (a) I make narrow (strictly: by pressure); I press upon, (b) I persecute, press hard.

θνησκω.def: I die, am dying, am dead.

θορυβεω.gloss: I disturb greatly, terrify, strike with panic
θορυβεω.def: I disturb greatly, terrify, strike with panic; mid: I show agitation of mind.

θορυβοσ.def: (a) din, hubbub, confused noise, outcry, (b) riot, disturbance.

θραυω.def: I crush, break, shatter; met: I break down.

θρεμμα.def: (lit: a nursling, hence probably) plur: cattle.

θρηνεω.def: intrans: I lament, wail; trans: I bewail.

θρησκεια.def: (underlying sense: reverence or worship of the gods), worship as expressed in ritual acts, religion.

θρησκοσ.def: (refers probably to a careful observance of religious restrictions), religious (probably in a limited sense), devout.

θριαμβευω.gloss: I lead around, make a spectacle of
θριαμβευω.def: (properly: I lead one as my prisoner in a triumphal procession, hence) I lead around, make a show (spectacle) of, cause to triumph.

θριξ.def: hair (of the head or of animals).

θροεω.def: I disturb, agitate; pass: I am troubled, alarmed.

θρονοσ.def: a (king's) throne, seat; meton: power, dominion; a potentate.

θυατειρα.def: Thyatira, a city of the old district Lydia, in the Roman province Asia.

θυγατηρ.def: a daughter; hence (Hebraistic?), of any female descendent, however far removed; even of one unrelated: my young lady.

θυμιατηριον.def: (ordinarily: censer, but) either the altar of incense, or the shovel, on which the high-priest poured the coals, when he entered the Holy of Holies on the Day of Atonement.

θυμομαχεω.def: (lit: I fight desperately, hence) I am furiously angry with.

θυμοω.gloss: I provoke to anger, am full of angry passion
θυμοω.def: I provoke to anger; pass: I am wroth or very angry.

θυσια.def: abstr. and concr: sacrifice; a sacrifice, offering.

θυω.def: I sacrifice, generally an animal; hence: I kill.

θωμασ.def: Thomas, also called Didymus, one of the Twelve.
